def main():
    n = int(input())
    ones = [0] * 17
    for i in range(1, 17):
        ones[i] = 10 * ones[i - 1] + 1

    def recursive_compute(ones, n, index):
        quotient = n // ones[index]
        remainder = n % ones[index]
        total_used = quotient * index
        if remainder == 0:
            return total_used
        else:
            optionA = recursive_compute(ones, remainder, index - 1)
            optionB = index + recursive_compute(ones, ones[index] - remainder, index - 1)
            return total_used + min(optionA, optionB)

    result = recursive_compute(ones, n, 16)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
